combinations.readout: percent reversal of mechanical allodynia (morphine 5 mg/kg)
combinations.magnitude: 58 ± 15 % with morphine alone vs 100 ± 0 % with RAP-103 0.5 mg/kg added (P<.01); RAP-103 alone inactive; two-way ANOVA interaction not significant (P=.075)
combinations.evidence_quote: While the mean (±SEM) extent to which morphine alone at 5 mg/kg reversed mechanical allodynia was 58 ± 15 %, addition of RAP-103 0.5 mg/kg increased this effect to 100 ± 0 % (P < .01).

combinations.readout: morphine ED50 for reversal of mechanical allodynia
combinations.magnitude: ED50 3.19 to 1.42 mg/kg, 2.3-fold leftward shift (P<.05); two-way ANOVA interaction for the 5 mg/kg groups not significant (P=.075)
combinations.evidence_quote: Thus, co-administration of RAP-103 (0.5 mg/kg) with morphine significantly shifted the morphine-dose response to the left by 2.3-fold (P < .05, paired one-tailed Student’s t-test, Fig. 2B).
